a: You must activate this effect at the start of your turn.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose not to activate this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect to avoid trashing any cards?

Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect activate even when my opponent’s security stack is empty?

Card Q&A.a: No. When there are no digivolution cards, you can't perform "trash the top card of this Digimon," so it doesn't activate.
